note: Editorial directory reviewed against linked City pages. Confirm current requirements, hours, fees and eligibility with the City before acting.

items.title: Report a neighborhood concern
items.description: Find the City’s eGOV reporting route for maintenance, sanitation and neighborhood concerns.
items.prepare: Have the location, a short description and a photo ready if it is safe to take one. Keep your service-request number for follow-up. This is not an emergency reporting service.
items.keywords: 311 pothole sidewalk streetlight noise complaint egov

items.title: Resident parking & permits
items.description: Find residential parking zones, permit programs and the official online parking portal.
items.prepare: Start with your address and permit type. The Customer Service Center asks for vehicle registration, proof of residency and the relevant application. Check the current checklist before applying.
items.keywords: car garage meter visitor pass discount zone permit

items.title: Garbage, recycling & bulk waste
items.description: Find collection information, bulk disposal options and help with a missed pickup.
items.prepare: Use the Sanitation Division’s current instructions for your property type. Confirm pickup arrangements and accepted materials before leaving bulky items outside.
items.keywords: trash furniture recycling bulk pickup waste missed collection

items.title: Take the free trolley
items.description: See citywide trolley routes, live tracking guidance and service information.
items.prepare: Check the route and current service notices before traveling. The City links to tracking tools and customer support from its trolley page.
items.keywords: bus transit transportation mobility live tracker route

items.title: Start a permit or renovation
items.description: Find the right department’s checklists, guides and permitting resources in one place.
items.prepare: Gather your property address and a description of the work. Requirements vary by project; use the applicable City checklist rather than assuming all work follows the same process.
items.keywords: building renovation construction inspection planning zoning business license

items.title: Flooding & storm preparation
items.description: Use the City’s flood-awareness resources to understand local risks and find preparation information.
items.prepare: Check official notices for current conditions. This site does not provide live weather, flood depths or emergency alerts.
items.keywords: king tide rain hurricane storm resilience water emergency

items.title: Housing & community support
items.description: Find the City office responsible for housing services, community assistance and homelessness response.
items.prepare: Programs have their own eligibility and availability requirements. Contact the office through its official page to find the appropriate service and current application process.
items.keywords: rent assistance affordable homeless seniors social community

items.title: Get help with city services
items.description: The Customer Service Center helps with services including parking permits, business licensing and passports.
items.prepare: Check the service-specific documents and appointment options before visiting. The City lists the center at 1755 Meridian Avenue.
items.keywords: passport business tax license appointment billing utilities pay

items.title: Find a public record
items.description: Access the City Clerk’s records, ordinance and resolution registries, and official document archive.
items.prepare: Use a meeting date, agenda item number, ordinance number or a precise subject to narrow your search. A first-reading vote is not the same as a final adopted ordinance.
items.keywords: ordinance resolution document records clerk transparency

items.title: Speak at a commission meeting
items.description: Find meeting dates and the City’s instructions for attending, watching and participating.
items.prepare: Check the notice for the specific meeting, including its time, location, virtual access and comment instructions. Rules and arrangements can differ for special meetings.
items.keywords: public comment zoom citizens forum agenda meeting commission

items.title: Choose your city alerts
items.description: Subscribe directly with the City for the newsletters and notices that matter to you.
items.prepare: Choose the available topics on the official subscription page. This resident hub does not collect your email address or sign you up automatically.
items.keywords: email newsletter alert traffic update subscribe

items.title: Parks, programs & recreation
items.description: Find City parks, recreation programs, facilities and registration information.
items.prepare: Review current program schedules, registration requirements and fees on the official Parks & Recreation site.
items.keywords: children summer camp sports tennis pool recreation classes
